'''John Leech''' (21 July 1926 in [[Weybridge]], [[Surrey]] – 28 September 1992 in [[Scotland]]) was a British [[mathematician]] working in [[number theory]], [[geometry]] and [[combinatorial group theory]]. He is best known for his discovery of the [[Leech lattice]] in 1965. He also discovered [[taxicab numbers|Ta(3)]] in 1957. Leech was married to [[Jenifer Haselgrove]], a British radio scientist.
